swn_deluxe.title: Stars Without Number: Revised Edition — Deluxe Edition
swn_deluxe.availability: authorised copy supplied by the author; not redistributable, not in the repository
swn_deluxe.page_note: SWN prints a running head on recto pages only, so a section that opens on an even page is first seen on the following odd page; the recorded page is therefore never later than the text it names.

source.swn_srd: no verified SRD licence for SWN power text; the register records procedures, not prose

statuses.verified: an SWN procedure implemented in src/rules with tests that pin the printed numbers
statuses.verified_reuse: the identical procedure already exists for CWN; one resolver is shared and a test proves the SWN numbers
statuses.partial: some of the section is implemented and the remainder is named
statuses.missing: no implementation; the gap is recorded so it cannot be mistaken for coverage
statuses.unverified: an equivalent CWN procedure exists but equivalence to the SWN numbers has not been proven
statuses.not_applicable: setting text, an example, guidance, or a subsystem excluded by an explicit design decision

rows.title: Summary of Character Creation
rows.note: Checklist page; the procedures it lists are the rows below it, not a rule of its own.

rows.title: Attributes
rows.note: SWN's attribute band and modifiers are the same Without Number table CWN uses (p.6); one resolver, pinned by a test.

rows.title: Skills
rows.note: 2d6 + skill + attribute modifier with the -1 unskilled penalty (SWN p.7). CWN's resolver is used unchanged.

rows.title: Skill Checks

rows.title: Psionics
rows.note: The Effort engine is one implementation after #1105's reconciliation: capacity 1 + best(WIS,CON) mod + highest discipline rank, reservations by duration, torching, and snapshot persistence. Every eligible SWN technique is not implemented: the catalogue holds the six discipline cores and 20 authored NoöPunk techniques, not the book's complete per-discipline lists.
